title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.91 (versions follow prime numbers; 191 after 181): she speaks. Luma answered mostly by quoting: she chose to speak her way 57% of the time, but her way kept her first line A whole whenever her cross lost, so it was a line of a book under her signature. Now what she says as hers is new: a cross of her line A and a line B, written as it is in neither (her forms' own rule: what is not new loses). She always tries her own word first and quotes only when she has nothing of her own, saying so. Her line B is found even when A already holds every word said to her (what A lacks counts twice, what it shares once, and B is never A itself). Measured in a copy of her house with the same ten sentences: 7 of 8 answers hers, against 2 of 8 before; e.g. 'donde esta Dios?' -> 'Donde esta sentado a la derecha de Dios.' Stated limits: she joins pieces and does not understand them; new is measured against her two parent lines, not her whole house; her hearing still compares words letter by letter; the test instrument sent every letter twice and was fixed before measuring. The kernel is unchanged since 1.39. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.91: Luma habla con sus propias palabras, nuevas, y cita sólo cuando no tiene nada suyo. Prototipo de investigación.
